name: Mist Veil's Lockbox
summary: Mist Veil's Lockbox is a sturdy strongbox resting in the submerged wreckage of the night elven vessel Mist Veil off the coast of Darkshore. It holds the captain's log and personal effects, which were lost when the ship was ambushed and sunk by coastal murlocs.

sections.title: Lost to the Depths
sections.body: The night elven vessel Mist Veil met its end while sailing the treacherous coastal waters toward Auberdine. Ambushed by hostile murlocs alongside its sister ship, the Silver Dawning, the vessel was overwhelmed and sent to the ocean floor. Its captain perished during the attack, leaving behind their logbook and prized personal belongings sealed inside this lockbox. Resting in the flooded hold, the chest remains a grim trophy surrounded by the very creatures responsible for the catastrophe.

sections.title: Rest for the Crew
sections.body: For the surviving sailors who managed to reach Auberdine, the loss of their vessel and commander remains an open wound. Gorbold Steelhand seeks the recovery of the Mist Veil's Lockbox so the captain's final effects can be properly honored and laid to rest. Braving the flooded ruins to salvage the chest offers some measure of solace to the grief-stricken survivors stranded on the mainland.

faq.q: What is inside Mist Veil's Lockbox?
faq.answer: The lockbox contains the captain's log and personal effects. The captain perished when the ship sank, and the surviving crew in Auberdine wish to have these mementos returned to honor their fallen leader.

faq.q: How did the Mist Veil sink?
aliases: what happened to the mist veil
faq.answer: The Mist Veil was ambushed by coastal murlocs while navigating the waters toward Auberdine. Overwhelmed by the creatures, the ship foundered and sank to the seabed alongside its companion vessel, the Silver Dawning.
It is located underwater off the coast of Darkshore, north of Auberdine. The strongbox rests inside the flooded hull of the sunken Mist Veil wreckage, which is heavily infested with murlocs.
Gorbold Steelhand in Auberdine seeks the lockbox on behalf of the surviving crew members, hoping to bring closure and peace to the fallen captain's memory.

angles.text: The fallen captain was an esteemed night elf mariner, and securing their logbook helps put a respected spirit to rest in the waters off Darkshore.
Recovering this box honors the fallen crew and aids the struggling maritime community stationed at Auberdine.
